note: Independent re-audit against RFC 9069 Section 5.1 ('Peer BGP ID: Set the ID to the router-id of the VRF instance if VRF is used; otherwise, set to the global instance router-id.') at HEAD. locRIBPeerHeader sets PeerBGPID from localIdentity().routerID and writePeerHeader encodes it big-endian at offsets 30..34; missing identity suppresses emission rather than emitting zero. TestLocRIBPeerHeader asserts ph.PeerBGPID == 0x0a141e01. Single-polarity annotation holds (Ze has one global instance and no VRF Loc-RIB instances).
